options.text: `http.HandleFunc("/path", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {...})` yoki `http.ServeMux` + `http.ListenAndServe(":8080", mux)`; har so'rov alohida goroutine'da ishlanadi — framework shart emas

questions.explanation: Go 1.22 `ServeMux`: metod va path parametrlar (`mux.HandleFunc("GET /users/{id}", ...)`, `r.PathValue("id")`) — ko'p holatda router kutubxonasi kerak emas. Production: `http.Server{ReadTimeout, WriteTimeout, IdleTimeout}` — default timeout'siz server xavfli (slowloris).

options.text: `Handler` — `ServeHTTP(w, r)` metodli interfeys; `HandlerFunc` — funksiya turi, u `ServeHTTP` implement qiladi (o'zini chaqiradi) — oddiy funksiyani `Handler`ga aylantiruvchi adapter; butun `net/http` shu bitta interfeys ustida

options.hint: Istalgan tur — funksiya ham (`HandlerFunc` shuni ko'rsatadi).

questions.explanation: Bu Go idiomasi: funksiya turiga metod qo'shish. Natija: middleware, router, handler — hammasi `Handler`; istalgan kutubxona bir-biri bilan mos. `http.StripPrefix`, `http.FileServer`, `http.TimeoutHandler` — tayyor Handler'lar.

questions.prompt: HTTP handler'da JSON so'rovni o'qish va javob yozish qanday qilinadi?

options.text: `r.Body` satr sifatida o'qib, qo'lda parse qilish

options.hint: Body yozilgach status 200 qotadi — "superfluous WriteHeader" ogohlantirish.

questions.explanation: `http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 1<<20)` — katta body'dan himoya. `dec.DisallowUnknownFields()` — qattiq validatsiya. Struct teglar: `json:"name,omitempty"`. Xato javoblari — bir xil format (`{"error": ...}`) uchun helper. `r.Body` yopish shart emas (server yopadi), lekin to'liq o'qish keep-alive uchun foydali.

questions.prompt: Quyidagi HTTP klient kodida qanday muammo bor?

options.text: `resp.Body.Close()` yo'q — ulanish sizadi (pool to'ladi); status kod tekshirilmaydi; `Decode` xatosi e'tiborsiz; `http.Get` default klient timeout'siz (abadiy osilishi mumkin); context yo'q

options.hint: Yaxshi fikr, lekin resurs va xato muammolari jiddiyroq.
Har chaqiruvda TCP ulanish nima bo'ladi? Server 500 bersa?

questions.explanation: To'g'ri: `defer resp.Body.Close()`, `if resp.StatusCode != 200`, `if err := dec.Decode(&u); err != nil`. O'z klient: `&http.Client{Timeout: 10 * time.Second}` yoki `http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, ...)`. Body'ni to'liq o'qish (`io.Copy(io.Discard, resp.Body)`) — ulanishni qayta ishlatish uchun.

options.text: `func(next http.Handler) http.Handler` — handler'ni o'rab, oldin/keyin ish qiladi va `next.ServeHTTP(w, r)` chaqiradi; zanjir: `logging(auth(mux))`; so'rovga ma'lumot qo'shish — `r.WithContext(context.WithValue(...))`

options.hint: Race va test muammosi; context/o'rama to'g'ri.

questions.explanation: Status kodni log qilish — `ResponseWriter`ni o'rash (`WriteHeader`ni ushlash). Tartib muhim: recover eng tashqarida, auth router'dan oldin yoki marshrut bo'yicha. `alice`/`chi` — zanjir qulayligi, lekin g'oya bir xil. Middleware har so'rovda ishlaydi — yengil bo'lsin.

options.text: Klient ulanishni uzsa yoki server Shutdown bo'lsa context bekor qilinadi — DB so'rov, tashqi chaqiruv, og'ir ish `ctx` orqali to'xtaydi (resurs tejash); middleware qiymatlari (request id, user) ham shu context'da; har pastki chaqiruvga `ctx` uzatiladi

options.hint: Header — `r.Header`; context — bekor qilish va metadata.
Klient uzilishi — asosiy holat; timeout — `http.TimeoutHandler` yoki `WithTimeout`.
Klient ketgan so'rov uchun 5 soniyalik DB so'rovini davom ettirish — isrof.

questions.explanation: Tuzoq: `r.Context()`ni javob yozilgandan keyin fon ishida ishlatish — bekor qilingan; `context.WithoutCancel(r.Context())` (1.21). Handler'dan goroutine boshlash — uning hayot siklini o'ylang. `ctx.Err()` — `Canceled` vs `DeadlineExceeded` farqlash (log/metrika).

options.text: Xatodan keyin `return` yo'q — 401 yozilgach `next` baribir chaqiriladi (himoya ishlamaydi, "superfluous WriteHeader"); context kaliti satr (`"user"`) — kolliziya xavfi, tipli kalit (`type ctxKey struct{}`) kerak

questions.explanation: "Xatodan keyin return unutish" — Go'da eng ko'p uchraydigan handler xatosi (exception yo'q, oqim davom etadi). Context kaliti: `type key int; const userKey key = 0` yoki `struct{}` — boshqa paket bilan to'qnashmaydi, `staticcheck SA1029` ogohlantiradi. Helper: `UserFrom(ctx) (User, bool)`.

questions.prompt: Go HTTP handler'larini qanday test qilish kerak?

options.text: `net/http/httptest`: `httptest.NewRequest` + `httptest.NewRecorder()` → `handler.ServeHTTP(rec, req)` → `rec.Code`, `rec.Body` tekshirish — serversiz, tez; tashqi API uchun `httptest.NewServer` fake server; table-driven testlar
Faqat real serverni ishga tushirib curl bilan

questions.explanation: Handler bog'liqliklarini (service, repo) interfeys orqali inject qiling — testda fake. `t.Run` subtest'lar, `t.Parallel`. Butun router orqali (`mux.ServeHTTP`) — marshrutlash ham tekshiriladi. Golden fayllar JSON javob uchun. `-race` bilan.

questions.prompt: Go HTTP klientida connection pool va timeout'lar qanday to'g'ri sozlanadi?

options.text: Bitta `http.Client` qayta ishlatiladi (ichida `Transport` pool); `Transport{MaxIdleConns, MaxIdleConnsPerHost (default 2!), IdleConnTimeout}`; timeout qatlamlari — `Client.Timeout` (butun so'rov), `DialContext`, `TLSHandshakeTimeout`, `ResponseHeaderTimeout`; body'ni to'liq o'qib yopish — ulanish pool'ga qaytsin

options.hint: Pool yo'qoladi — har so'rov yangi TCP/TLS; `TIME_WAIT` portlar tugaydi.
Timeout'siz — tashqi servis osilsa goroutine'lar to'planadi.

questions.explanation: `MaxIdleConnsPerHost=2` default — bitta backend'ga ko'p so'rovda ulanishlar yopilib-ochiladi; 100 ga oshirish odatiy. Retry — faqat idempotent va `Request.GetBody` bilan. HTTP/2 — bitta ulanish, multiplekslash. `httptrace` — har bosqich vaqtini o'lchash.

questions.prompt: HTTP serverda panic'dan himoya va xatolarni markazlashtirilgan ishlov qanday tashkil qilinadi?

options.text: Recover middleware eng tashqi qatlamda (`net/http` o'zi panic'ni ushlab ulanishni yopadi, lekin log/metrika/500 javob uchun o'zingiz); handler'lar `error` qaytaradigan o'z tipingiz (`func(w, r) error`) + adapter — xato turi bo'yicha status mapping bir joyda, loglash bir joyda
`net/http` panic'ni o'zi ishlaydi, hech narsa kerak emas
options.hint: Ulanish yopiladi, lekin log kontekstsiz, metrika yo'q, klient tushunarsiz uzilish oladi.
Butun server o'ladi — bitta so'rov uchun.

questions.explanation: Pattern: `type HandlerE func(w, r) error`; adapter `ServeHTTP`da `errors.As(err, &apiErr)` → status, aks holda 500 + log + Sentry. `http.ErrAbortHandler` — ataylab panic (recover o'tkazib yuborsin). Handler'dan boshlangan goroutine'dagi panic — server recover'i ushlamaydi, butun jarayon o'ladi — alohida recover.

questions.prompt: Go servisida rate limiting va so'rov hajmini cheklash qanday amalga oshiriladi?

options.text: `golang.org/x/time/rate` (token bucket) — global yoki per-klient (map + Mutex/ttl bilan) middleware'da, 429 + `Retry-After`; `http.MaxBytesReader` body uchun; `Server.ReadHeaderTimeout` header uchun; konkurent so'rovlar — semafor channel; taqsimlangan limit — Redis
Rate limiting faqat API gateway'da bo'lishi kerak
options.hint: Gateway — birinchi qatlam; servis o'zini ham himoya qiladi (defense in depth).

options.text: Go'da cheklash kerak emas — goroutine'lar arzon
options.hint: Goroutine arzon, DB ulanish va xotira — yo'q.

questions.explanation: `rate.NewLimiter(r, b)` — `Allow()` (rad) yoki `Wait(ctx)` (kutish). Per-IP map — eskirgan yozuvlarni tozalash (goroutine yoki LRU). Load shedding — navbat uzunligi/latency bo'yicha 503. Bu Go'da `net/http` ustida 50 qator — framework shart emas.

questions.prompt: Go'da gRPC va REST o'rtasida tanlov va gRPC servis dizayni qanday?

options.text: gRPC — servislar orasida: protobuf kontrakt (kod generatsiya, tur xavfsizligi, kichik hajm), HTTP/2 streaming, deadline/metadata tarqalishi, interceptor'lar (middleware); REST/JSON — tashqi/brauzer klientlar, oddiy debug; ko'p tizimda ikkalasi (grpc-gateway). Dizayn: `.proto` — API egasi, backward-compatible o'zgarish (maydon raqamlari), xato kodlari `status`, health check, reflection

options.hint: Brauzer to'g'ridan-to'g'ri gRPC gaplasha olmaydi (grpc-web proxy); debug qiyinroq.
Yuqori yuklamali ichki trafik, streaming — gRPC sezilarli samara.
gRPC Go — eng yetuk implementatsiyalardan biri.

questions.explanation: Go gRPC: `protoc-gen-go` + `protoc-gen-go-grpc` yoki `buf` (lint, breaking change tekshiruvi). Interceptor — auth, logging, metrika, recovery. Context deadline — klientdan serverga avtomatik. Load balancing — klient tomonda (HTTP/2 uzoq ulanish — L4 LB taqsimlamaydi) yoki service mesh.

questions.prompt: Go web servisida kuzatuvchanlik (observability) qanday tashkil qilinadi?

options.text: Strukturali log (`log/slog`, 1.21+) request id/trace id bilan; metrikalar — Prometheus (`promhttp`, RED: rate, errors, duration — histogram) + `expvar`/runtime metrikalar; trace — OpenTelemetry SDK, HTTP/gRPC/DB instrumentatsiya, context orqali span tarqalishi; `net/http/pprof` endpoint (himoyalangan port) — production profiling; health/readiness endpoint'lar

options.hint: Strukturasiz, qidirish qiyin, level yo'q, kontekst yo'q.
Production'da pprof — Go'ning eng kuchli afzalliklaridan biri; faqat ichki portda.

questions.explanation: `slog` — `slog.With("request_id", id)` handler'ga uzatiladi; JSON output. Middleware RED metrikani har marshrut uchun (label kardinalligi — path shablon, real URL emas!). OTel — bitta SDK, exporter almashtiriladi (Jaeger, Tempo, vendor). Continuous profiling (Pyroscope, Parca) — pprof ustida.
